lessons.goal: 辨認訊息中的版本與更正，排除舊檔。

questions.evidence: Drama club chat: Please practice with the recording named Scene Three Final. I uploaded it this morning after changing the last two lines. The older recording is still in the folder, but its title ends with Draft and its ending is different.
questions.explanation: 檔名 Draft 的舊錄音結尾不同。
questions.prompt: Which file contains an older ending?

questions.evidence: Mia: The new recording is quieter than the old one. Director: I will raise the volume this afternoon without changing any words. The new copy will still have Final in its name, followed by Audio Fix.
questions.explanation: 下午只提高音量，不改文字。
questions.prompt: What will the director change in the afternoon?

questions.evidence: Noah: I downloaded a file last night and listened to it on the bus. Should I delete it? Director: Keep it only if you want to compare the versions. For rehearsal, use today's final recording and the script dated October twenty-first.
questions.explanation: 導演允許保留舊版做比較。
options: To use its ending in the next rehearsal.
To avoid reading the final script.
questions.prompt: Why might Noah keep the old file?

questions.evidence: Noah: Then the words in Final and Final Audio Fix will match? Director: Exactly. The draft is the one with different lines. Please tell me about any unclear sound before tomorrow's rehearsal, so I can fix it in time.
questions.explanation: 問兩份正式錄音文字是否一致。
questions.prompt: What does 'match' mean in Noah's question?

options: Draft and last night's bus message.
questions.prompt: Which two recordings have the same words?
